question: The upper portion of the mantle is called ____________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**asthenosphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asthenosphere:-**

 
 
• The upper portion of the mantle is called the asthenosphere (astheno means weak). (Hence option 1 is correct).
 
• It lies just below the crust extending up to 80-200 km.
 
• It is highly viscous, mechanically weak and ductile and its density is higher than that of the crust.
 
• These properties of the asthenosphere aid in plate tectonic movement and isostatic adjustments (the elevated part at one part of the crust area is counterbalanced by a depressed part at another).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Mesosphere:

 
 
• The mesosphere is the layer of the atmosphere where the shooting stars blaze.
 
• It is extended from 50 km to 80 km above the earth's surface.
 
• The space debris begins to burn up as it enters the mesosphere.
 
 
 
• **Barosphere:-**
 
 
• It is the part of an atmosphere below the exosphere.
 
• **It is the region of the atmosphere where the air pressure is high enough to support life. **
 
• The barosphere extends from the Earth's surface to an altitude of about 100 kilometers (62 miles).
 
 
 
• **Lithosphere:-**
 
 
• **It is the rigid, outermost shell of a terrestrial planet or natural satellite. **
 
• On Earth, it is composed of the crust and the lithospheric mantle, the topmost portion of the upper mantle that behaves elastically on time scales of up to thousands of years or more.
